subject: Cardinal Health deletion request — prompts/outputs/logs purge
messages:
From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Cardinal Health Legal <legal@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2029 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deletion request: Cardinal Health tenant - prompts & logs

Hi Laura,

Per our compliance schedule, Cardinal Health needs Redwood to execute a scoped purge for tenant CH-1982. Scope requested:
- All prompts and assistant outputs generated by CH-1982 (prompt logs, transcripts, completions).
- Runtime logs (access and inference request logs) for the timeframe 2026-01-01 through 2029-12-01.
- KV/prefix caches related to CH-1982.

Please confirm:
1) What exact artifacts you will remove vs. what you can only mark as expired/archived for audit reasons.
2) ETA for completion; target is EOD Friday 2029-12-06.
3) Whether you can provide a signed manifest and hash-based proof of deletion.

I've attached the formal deletion request from our legal team. Let me know if you need a PO or further sign-off.

Thanks,
Ethan Miller
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Cardinal Health
Attachment: cardinal-deletion-request.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2029 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Deletion request: Cardinal Health tenant - prompts & logs

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear request and the PDF. We received this and have kicked off an internal intake. High-level plan: 

1) Intake & validation (today): we confirm tenant ID CH-1982, residency = US, and scope.
2) Ops purge (engineers): run targeted purge for prompt outputs, transcripts, and KV/prefix caches.
3) Log redaction: redact PII from access logs where required, and remove inference-level request logs per our retention policy when eligible.
4) Deliverable: signed erase manifest (CSV) + audit link + short runbook summary.

ETA: we expect to complete the purge and provide the manifest by 2029-12-04 EOD Pacific, barring edge cases (data in cold archive or third-party audit holds). If anything requires a longer window we will escalate immediately.

Action items for us (cc'd):
- Marissa: confirm log sources and retention windows, and whether redaction is needed for any PII in access logs.
- Ben: prepare erase manifest and proof bundle; include token counts removed where possible.
- Priyom: validate that CH-1982 has no active long-term snapshots in our S3 cold archive and confirm wipe approach for KV caches.

I've created a JIRA ticket for tracking: CH-8743. Attaching preliminary intake form.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: cardinal-deletion-request.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Deletion request intake - CH-8743 (internal)

Folks — moving this into ops lane. A couple technical clarifications before we commit to the Dec 4 ETA: 

- Log sources: inference request logs live in prod-logs-1 (rotated monthly) and a copy is pushed to long-retention S3 bucket "redwood-logs-us". For retention windows > 90d we need to run a separate job to delete objects and then verify via S3 object inventory.
- KV caches: CH-1982 uses dedicated prefixing in our KV cluster; we can drop namespace entries and zero out keys. Confirm whether zeroization is acceptable or if legal requires cryptographic hash-of-deleted-objects proof.
- Cold archives: older snapshotted transcripts (2026-2027) may exist in Glacier-class storage tied to a cross-account archive. We'll need Priyom to confirm access and if a follow-on job is required.

Attachment: erase_manifest_template.csv (CSV) and purge-runbook-v3.md (text) — use these to capture the manifest fields we'll hand to the customer.

Ben/Priyom — can you reply with:
- Estimated wallclock time for S3 deletes + inventory verification (approx minutes/hours).
- The exact manifest columns you'll produce (we should include object key, storage class, deletion method, timestamp, operator).

Marissa
Senior Technical Program Manager — Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: erase_manifest_template.csv, purge-runbook-v3.md

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2029 18:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Completed: Cardinal Health (CH-1982) purge + manifest

Ethan — quick status and delivery. Per the scope in your PDF we executed the following for tenant CH-1982 (US residency):

Summary of actions completed (2029-12-04):
- Prompt outputs & assistant transcripts: removed 1,248,392 objects from prod-store-us (S3).
- KV/prefix caches: zeroized namespace ch-1982 in KV cluster (all keys deleted).
- Inference & request logs: removed 182,430 log objects from prod-logs-1 and long-retention S3 as eligible under your retention request; PII redaction performed on three access-log files as they contained service tokens.

We produced an erase manifest and a hash-based proof for files deleted from S3. Deliverables attached and accessible via the audit link below:
- Attached: cardinal-erase-manifest.csv (columns: object_key, storage_class, original_size_bytes, deletion_method, deletion_timestamp, sha256_before_delete)
- Audit evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XYZ
- DocuSign: signed manifest is available here: https://docusign.com/abc123

If you need a longer certificate of destruction (formal doc) we can generate a notarized bundle through our compliance team — this will add 2 business days.

Please reply to confirm receipt and acceptance of the manifest. If you have any gaps we will re-open CH-8743 and investigate immediately.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: cardinal-erase-manifest.csv

From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Cardinal Health Legal <legal@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Dec 2029 09:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Completed: Cardinal Health (CH-1982) purge + manifest

Ben/Laura — received, reviewed, and signed the manifest via DocuSign. Thanks for the quick turnaround and the audit link. We'll close our internal ticket and flag this as complete. Appreciate the proof bundle and the manifest format — it fits our audit needs.

Ethan Miller
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Cardinal Health
